name: herdr
description: Manage herdr coding agents and the workspaces that hold them, on this computer and on SSH machines saved in herdr. Includes a herdr page to follow agents, start new ones (optionally on a new git worktree) and answer them.
whenToUse: The user mentions herdr, herdr sessions/workspaces/tabs/panes, or wants to check, read, prompt, start, wait on or coordinate coding agents (Claude, Codex, Grok, Pi, etc.) running in herdr, locally or on a remote herdr machine (e.g. a dev box reachable over SSH).

tools.name: herdr_machines
tools.description: List where herdr can be reached: "local" (this computer) plus every SSH machine saved with `herdr machine add`, with its default remote session. Use the label as the `machine` argument of other herdr tools.

tools.name: herdr_sessions
tools.description: List named herdr sessions (persistent servers) on a machine and whether each is running.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label such as "devbox".

tools.name: herdr_overview
tools.description: Snapshot one herdr session: workspaces, tabs, panes (cwd, title) and recognized agents with their state (idle / working / blocked / done / unknown). Start here to discover ids. IDs are opaque and scoped to one machine+session; never reuse them across machines.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label. Remote machines default to their saved session.

session.description: Named herdr session, e.g. "agents". Omit for the default session (or the saved session of a remote machine).

tools.name: herdr_agent_get
tools.description: Show one agent's details and lifecycle state.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

target.description: Live agent name or the pane id hosting it (e.g. "w9:p1").

tools.name: herdr_read
tools.description: Read recent terminal output from a pane or agent (ANSI stripped). Use before deciding what to send, and after a wait returns blocked.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

target.description: Pane id ("w1:p2") or live agent name.

source.description: Snapshot source; default recent-unwrapped (best for logs/transcripts).

tools.name: herdr_prompt_agent
tools.description: Submit a prompt to a coding agent running in herdr and, by default, wait until it settles (idle/done/blocked). Returns the final state; then use herdr_read to get its answer. Rejected with AGENT_BLOCKED if the agent is waiting on an approval/question: read it and ask the user before answering. A timeout does not prove the prompt was not delivered; do not resend blindly.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

target.description: Live agent name or pane id hosting the agent.

text.description: Prompt text, passed through as the user wrote it. Cannot start with "-".

wait.description: Wait for the agent to settle (default true).

tools.name: herdr_wait_agent
tools.description: Wait until an agent reaches a state. Without `until`, waits for idle, done or blocked.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

target.description: Live agent name or pane id.

tools.name: herdr_send_keys
tools.description: Send logical key presses (e.g. esc, enter, ctrl+c, up) to an agent or pane, optionally typing literal text first (text needs a pane id). Only answer an agent's approval/question UI when the user told you what to choose.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

target.description: Agent name, or pane id (contains ":") for raw pane keys.

keys.description: Key names in order, e.g. ["esc"] or ["ctrl+c"]; pressed after text.

text.description: Optional literal text typed before the keys (no Enter). Needs a pane id target. Cannot start with "-".

tools.name: herdr_run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command in an existing pane (text + Enter). Optionally wait for a literal substring to appear in its output. The pane should be at a shell prompt, not running an agent.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

wait_for.description: Optional literal text to wait for in the output.

timeout_ms.description: Wait limit when wait_for is set (default 60000).

tools.name: herdr_wait_output
tools.description: Wait until a pane's recent output contains a literal substring or matches a Rust regex. Existing output can match immediately.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

regex.description: Rust regex to wait for (used instead of match).

tools.name: herdr_split_pane
tools.description: Split an existing pane to create a new shell pane next to it, without stealing the user's focus. Returns the new pane id in result.pane.pane_id. Split wide panes right, narrow/tall panes down.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

cwd.description: Optional absolute working directory on that machine; defaults to herdr's choice.

focus.description: Move focus to the new pane. Only true if the user asked.

tools.name: herdr_start_agent
tools.description: Start a supported coding agent (claude, codex, grok, pi, cursor, gemini, opencode, ...) in an existing pane that is at a shell prompt. Usually split a pane first. Returns once the agent is ready; then use herdr_prompt_agent.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

name.description: Unique agent name: lowercase, starts with a letter, up to 32 chars, e.g. "reviewer".

kind.description: Agent kind requested by the user, e.g. claude, codex, grok, pi, cursor, gemini, opencode, copilot, amp.

pane_id.description: Existing pane at an interactive shell prompt.

agent_args.description: Optional native CLI args for the agent.

tools.name: herdr_workspace
tools.description: Manage herdr workspaces, only when the user asked. action create: new workspace in a folder; tab_create: new tab in workspace_id; worktree_create: new git branch + worktree checkout opened as a workspace (cwd or workspace_id must be inside the repo); worktree_open: open an existing worktree by path or branch; rename: relabel workspace_id; worktree_list: list worktrees of a repo. For the four create/open actions, set agent_kind to start that coding agent in the new root pane (returns agent.status ready or blocked; blocked means it is waiting on a prompt such as folder trust: read it with herdr_read and answer only as the user decides). If the agent fails to start, a new plain workspace/tab is closed again; worktrees are kept. Never takes the user's focus unless focus is true.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

cwd.description: Folder on that machine: absolute or "~/...". For create/tab_create the new shell starts there; for worktree actions it is any folder inside the git repository.

workspace_id.description: Existing workspace: required for tab_create and rename; for worktree actions it can replace cwd to name the repository.

branch.description: worktree_create: new branch name (required). worktree_open: branch to open (or give path).

base.description: worktree_create: ref to branch from (default: the repository's current HEAD).

agent_kind.description: Coding agent to start in the new root pane. Omit to only create.

agent_name.description: Unique agent name: lowercase, starts with a letter, up to 32 chars. Default <kind>-<random>.

agent_args.description: Optional native CLI args for the agent.

focus.description: Switch the user's view to it. Only true if the user asked.

tools.name: herdr_focus
tools.description: Switch the herdr UI focus to a workspace, tab or agent. Only when the user asked to switch.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

id.description: Workspace id, tab id, or agent name / pane id.

tools.name: herdr_close
tools.description: Close a pane, tab or workspace, stopping the processes in it; or, with kind "worktree", remove the git worktree checkout behind a workspace (closes it and deletes the folder; the branch is kept). Only call when the user explicitly asked for that specific item. The user must also approve a confirmation dialog; if they decline (USER_DECLINED), do not retry.

machine.description: "local" (default) or a saved herdr machine label.

session.description: Named herdr session; omit for default.

id.description: Pane, tab or workspace id; for kind worktree, the worktree workspace id.

force.description: kind worktree only: remove even with uncommitted changes. Only if the user explicitly asked.
